name: POST /api/admin/auth/step-up - Step-up re-authentication
description: Re-confirms the administrator's password and issues a short-lived step-up token. Every MUTATING admin action (access change, plan override, credit grant, message send) requires a step-up token, so a stolen or unattended admin session cannot change customer accounts on its own.

testCases.name: Confirm password to elevate the admin session

errorCases.message: Password is required to complete step-up verification
errorCases.when: password is absent from the body
The supplied password does not match
The caller is authenticated but is not a platform_admin (a tenant-level admin is refused here)

errorCases.message: Platform administrator access has been revoked
errorCases.when: The admin's own access_status is suspended or revoked
